official_evidence.finding: Official site describes Shopify-native product recommendation quizzes and declares shopper attributes before recommendation; the Japanese pet-food retail wedge is an application hypothesis.
Official case study describes a personalized pet meal-plan quiz on a Shopify store, supporting the product-workflow fit.
Official partner program is for agencies and consultants; no Japanese partner was verified.

draft.subject: Quizell — Japan rollout for guided pet-food selection
draft.body:
Hi Quizell team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company supporting commerce technology companies with Japan market development. We’re contacting Quizell about pet-profile quizzes for Japanese Shopify pet-food retailers, helping shoppers match diets to age, size, and needs.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean pet retail teams, guided selection could reduce repetitive suitability questions before checkout.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide Japanese question flows, result wording, and deployment priorities. Can we help plan and execute Quizell’s Japan rollout for these retailers?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
